description: Ready-to-use machines: the application installed at creation (JupyterLab, Ollama + Open WebUI, vLLM OpenAI compatible server, ComfyUI, PyTorch environment). Pass templateId (and templateModel for vllm) to gpucloud_quote_server / gpucloud_create_server. Every exposed application requires authentication and is served over HTTPS only (publicly trusted certificate, port 80 only redirects); the generated credentials are shown to the owner in the web console only. Works without a key. (permission: catalog:read)
name: gpucloud_list_templates
title: List one-click templates
